response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean1 FROM st), k1 AS (SELECT st.equipstatus, st.avg_pulse, st.avg_pulse - m1.mean1 AS excess1 FROM st, m1 WHERE st.avg_pulse > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.avg_pulse, k1.excess1, k1.avg_pulse - m2.mean2 AS excess2 FROM k1, m2 WHERE k1.avg_pulse > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(excess1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(excess2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM k2

assumptions.assumption: Each status's average is the average over all signals (rows) detected by telescopes in that status, not an average of per-telescope averages.
A NULL equipstatus, if present, forms its own group and counts as a status in the means.
The 'mean of all status averages' is an unweighted mean of the per-status averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Compute each telescope's average pulse rate first, then average those per-telescope averages within each equipment status (telescopes weighted equally rather than signals).
